description:
[narrowed from route-edit-4ad6a328] Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-cutover.ts to add a PRE-cutover test gate, reusing the post-land machinery that already exists.

INSERT the new gate immediately AFTER this line, which occurs exactly once in the file (verbatim):
  if (evaluation_evidence.verdict !== "FAVORABLE") {

The block to reuse is further down and begins with this line, which also occurs exactly once (verbatim):
    const suite = await resolveTestSuite({

That existing block runs resolveTestSuite AFTER the commit lands, reads sb.failingTests, diffs those test NAMES against the per-vessel baseline file under /workspace/post-land-baseline/, and files a substrateGap for tests that are NEWLY failing. Do not duplicate that logic — factor the suite-run-plus-baseline-diff into one helper and call it from both places.

Required behaviour of the new pre-cutover call: run the suite against the mitosis tree before the track is promoted; compute the same newly-failing set difference against the vessel baseline; if that set is non-empty, re-run once to confirm and refuse the cutover only if the same test names fail again; log the requested and confirmed counts so a refusal is legible. Do NOT gate on a raw pass/fail count — the suite sits in an 81 to 94 failure band and only the set difference is meaningful. Leave the existing post-land block in place unchanged as the fallback for when the pre-cutover run cannot execute.

Closes substrate gap cutover-suite-observes-but-does-not-gate.
